Bombay High Court Halts Demolition of Dawood Ibrahim-Linked Mumbai Building

The Bombay High Court has halted the demolition of an 87-year-old building in Mumbai that was once linked to Dawood Ibrahim. The building had been classified as C-1, indicating it was a dangerous structure. Bulldozers had begun moving in on the property.
